L1 canonical planner. Preserve all historical round12–14 raw evidence and outside lessons. New active tool tools/context-capture.py promotes historical capture-context.py without editing historical bytes. Context source docs opened this round support sourced C1. No successor sweep or seventh case.
# Contract
Root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin; every Report: trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin/<that path>. Your report is the only write unless Target assigns another absolute path. Coordinate only agent://TameshiR15; never Main or agent://all. All seats leaf, no delegation, no checks/build/tests/formatters mid-flight, no commits. Read AGENTS.md and corpus/lessons/round-14-verifier-spotcheck.md Routed defects. Never read/copy/query/modify ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or credential/auth files, never launch omp CLI. Sibling/domain trees read-only; no sibling gates executed. Helpful tools authorized after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; record tool/version/channel/reason. Before pacman -S dry-run pacman -Sp --print-format '%n %v' pkgs; proceed only if every listed package is NOT installed (pacman -Q fails), else use uv/npx/official binary. Never -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade or restart host services. No installed-package upgrades. Every source claim is bounded; no self-dispatched seat is independent admission authority. Finish file work and report evidence, not future promises.
# Integration interface
Gate executor owns tools/context-capture.py. Preserve historical script entirely. Promote maintained command with --selftest and a useful retained-receipt check CLI, digest-bound snapshot mode if needed by gate standard; reuse decide/comparison/mapping semantics, no new broad environment claims. Selftest invokes actual public CLI subprocesses on isolated synthetic fixtures, pins literal expected exits+stable IDs, no live reads/network/writes outside temp roots. Normal prospective capture writes round15 only; never overwrite round14. L1 runs all checks once after seats return. Other seats inspect historical source/contracts or supply distinct fixture/spec advice; do not fabricate executed results.
